group_results.reason: The changed private-key parser declaration requires an RNG callback and context; the target's sole call supplies neither.
The implementation likewise has the expanded parser signature, so the old call cannot compile.

build.reason: CMake defines fuzz_privkey from its C source, and the recipe builds programs/fuzz. The old six-argument call conflicts with the eight-argument declaration. The recipe's fallback and final true can hide this failure but do not produce a valid target.

input.reason: The entry accepts fuzzer bytes, caps their length, and forwards the resulting buffer and length to the private-key parser. The parser handles zero length and checks the key pointer; PEM input can be selected by a terminating NUL, while other bytes proceed to DER parsing.

lifecycle.reason: The target initializes its PK context before parsing and frees it afterward, including after parse errors. The source initialization and free functions support that sequence.

control_flow.reason: The intended entry route is initialize, parse, inspect successful RSA or EC keys, then free. Compilation fails at the parse call before that route can execute in the changed build.

missing_information: Per-change resolution of the remaining selected change groups is pending; the established build blocker does not establish whole-scope sufficiency.

accepted.requirement: Pass the RNG callback and context required by mbedtls_pk_parse_key so fuzz_privkey compiles and can invoke private-key parsing.
accepted.target_route: The recipe configures CMake and builds programs/fuzz; its fuzz_privkey target compiles the old entry, whose sole parser call supplies six arguments.
accepted.failure_condition: The changed declaration and definition require eight arguments, producing a compile-time too-few-arguments error at the old call. The recipe can mask the failed build with its fallback and final true, but that does not restore this executable.
accepted.alternative_paths: No alternate parser call or delegated helper exists in the complete old fuzz_privkey entry. Its RSA and EC checks are reachable only after the failed call compiles and returns success.

source_evidence.quote:
foreach(exe IN LISTS executables_no_common_c executables_with_common_c)

    set(exe_sources ${exe}.c $<TARGET_OBJECTS:mbedtls_test>)
    if(NOT FUZZINGENGINE_LIB)
        list(APPEND exe_sources onefile.c)
    endif()

    # This emulates "if ( ... IN_LIST ... )" which becomes available in CMake 3.3
    list(FIND executables_with_common_c ${exe} exe_index)
    if(${exe_index} GREATER -1)
        list(APPEND exe_sources common.c)
    endif()

    add_executable(${exe} ${exe_sources})
    target_include_directories(${exe} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../tests/include)

    if (NOT FUZZINGENGINE_LIB)
        target_link_libraries(${exe} ${libs})
    else()
        target_link_libraries(${exe} ${libs} FuzzingEngine)
        SET_TARGET_PROPERTIES(${exe} PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
